## Description

A short, clear description of your idea or the improvement you suggest.

## Starter Kit (optional)

- [ ] Vision Starter Kit  
- [ ] LiDAR Starter Kit  
- [ ] IO-Link Connectivity Starter Kit

## Type (optional)

- [ ] New example project idea  
- [ ] Improvement to an existing project  
- [ ] New feature for the repository

## Use Case (optional)

Who would benefit from this, and in what scenario?

## Additional Context (optional)

Links, references, sketches, or any other helpful information.

---

### Notes

- You don't need to fill in every field. Fill in only what you know — the  
  more details, the easier it is for us to understand your idea.  
- Only the Description is really needed. All other sections are optional.  
- Replace the placeholder text under each heading with your own input, and  
  delete sections you don't need.  
- You can ignore the Assignee, Project and Milestone fields at the bottom.  
  Please leave them empty — the SICK team reviews new ideas and assigns  
  them to the right person.
